messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT hosted-api-prod • us-west-2 • request_queue_depth=823 (threshold=500) • 5xx_rate=18% • affected_model=r-instruct-v1 • https://pager.redwood/INC-335999

sanjay: ack, looking into pool-uw1. I'm seeing continuous-batcher backlog climbing and KV cache miss rate spiking.

jamie: customer (acct acme) reporting a bunch of 504/timeouts for generate API in the last 6m. any hotfixes we can try?

lisa: p95 latency jumped from 200ms -> 2.1s after 14:30, p99 ~ 7.8s. queue_depth graph looks like a sawtooth with big tail spikes. long-sequence requests appear to be filling batch windows.

maria: grabbing recent gateway logs, sample entry:```
[2026-02-12T14:32:10Z] tenant_id=acme req_id=af3c8 status=504 queue_depth=912 batch_wait_ms=250 outcome=timeout model=r-instruct-v1
```

sanjay: repro steps I used locally:```
# simulate long request load
for i in $(seq 1 20); do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"model":"r-instruct-v1","prompt":"'$(head -c 8000 /dev/urandom | base64)'"}' &\ndone
```fills the continuous-batcher backlog in ~30s on staging.

lisa: tried same in staging with 30 concurrent long requests — dequeue throughput drops, we observed dequeue_loop_time=1200ms and many batch windows hitting max_wait.

ingress-bot: Runbook check: suggested mitigations -> 1) tenant rate-limit 2) reduce max_batch_wait_ms for pool 3) fallback to smaller model variant 4) enable per-tenant long-seq circuit breaker (manual).

ops: quick mitigation applied: throttled tenant acme to 30rps and reduced pool-uw1 max_batch_wait_ms from 250ms -> 60ms. monitoring now.

maria: after throttling + batch_wait reduction queue_depth dropped from ~900 -> ~700 within 45s and 5xx rate started trending down. customer still seeing some residual 504s but much fewer.

jamie: i'll tell the support rep we applied mitigations and are monitoring; ask them to escalate if they see >5% error rate still.

sanjay: longer-term actions I recommend: implement adaptive batch window that shrinks when backlog > X, add per-tenant long-seq circuit breaker to reject/route very long requests to a dedicated path, and add an alarm on continuous-batcher backlog > 500. Avoid bumping queue_depth_limit without memory safety review.

lisa: capturing traces and attaching to the incident page now. will prepare a short postmortem template. :thumbsup:

ingress-bot: Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/queue-saturation • playbook steps followed: throttled tenant, lowered batch window, monitored KV cache warmup.

maria: note for follow-up: acme is using long chat completions via our hosted API; consider recommending Dedicated or Private deployment for heavy long-seq workloads.

jamie: thanks all — please leave any follow-ups here and i'll coordinate customer comms.
